generated_from: data/verified/*.json (pack v3, revised 2026-10-24 after the third review)
rules: Every engine function must reproduce these within tolerance.
Golden values are computed from the verified JSON; if a JSON value changes, regenerate this file, never hand-edit expected values.
'exact' means string/number equality with the JSON value.

Size keys: groups wire-size-60c, wire-size-errors, wire-size-termination, wire-size-derated, service-lookup, table-*, 240-4-D, ampacity-*, breaker-sizing, voltage-drop, dc-sizing, resistance and parallel use nec-310-16.json keys ('1/0', '4/0', '250'); groups awg-table, awg-geometry and weight use awg.json names ('0', '0000').

Group wire-size-termination: termination is 'unknown', '60' or '75' ('75' means the reader confirmed that every termination is listed and identified for 75 °C conductors); wiring_method is 'cable' (NM, UF or not sure: always 60 °C) or 'conductors' (individual conductors: termination rules apply).

EGC cap: until the NEC 250.122(A) sentence is verified, the EGC is not capped at the conductor size. Only 25 A aluminum gets a Table 250.122 EGC (8 AWG) larger than its conductor (10 AWG). egc null means no Table 310.16 size reaches the required area. wire-size-60c and wire-size-derated cases carry egc_larger_than_conductor.

Group wire-size-derated (WSZ-009): ambient_c_row is a Table 310.15(B)(1)(1) row key, ccc_band a Table 310.15(C)(1) row key or null for 1–3 conductors; termination and wiring_method as in wire-size-termination; start_column_c is 90 for individual conductors and 60 for cable; derated_ampacity is the baseline size's derated ampacity capped at its termination-column ampacity.

cases.name: 40 A OCPD, 25 A load, 250 ft, 240 V, Cu, conductors, terminations unknown, 36–40 °C, 4–6 current-carrying
cases.basis: WSZ-009 derating mode: load below the rating plus voltage-drop upsizing: the EGC scales from the derated size sized to the 40 A rating, not to the 25 A load. Termination column per nec-110-14c.json; start column 90 °C for individual conductors, 60 °C for cable; derated ampacity = start-column ampacity × Table 310.15(B)(1)(1) factor (start column) × Table 310.15(C)(1) percent, capped at the termination-column ampacity; baseline = smallest size whose derated ampacity is at least the OCPD rating, then 240.4(D); voltage drop at load current with 75 °C resistance; 250.122(B) scaling from the baseline, multiply-first, uncapped.
